outcome.label: Days the soil sits bare each year
outcome.note: Bare days mostly follow which crop is grown that year (a fallow year is bare by definition). A gap here is a difference in soil cover, not a measured change in the soil itself.

design.estimator: did = (post_A - pre_A) - (post_B - pre_B) over the years both fields have a value; effect = mean over matched pairs
